content.text: {"regions": [{"id": "r2", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "to an act. प्रतिनिविष्ट—obstinate in holding contrary opinions,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "perverse. Cf. निविशते Vair. S'a. Mis. sl. 19.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl, 5. सिकतासु—The word सिकता is always used in the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "plural. यत्नतः–fr. यत्+नङ् ( भावे ). तस् here stands for the instr.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "मृगतृष्णा एव मृगतृष्णिका by adding क स्वार्थे; mirage. It is a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "phenomenon observed in sandy tracts or deserts when the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "floating vapour or air is heated by the tropical sun and presents", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "the appearance of water. It is so called because it attracts and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "deceives the deer and other animals. सिकता-सुतैलं excellent oil", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "&c, मृगतृष्णिका-सुसलिलं sweet water—may also be regarded as", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "compound words. This way of taking the expressions is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "perhaps better as it adds to the force of the argument, and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "avoids प्रक्रमभङ्ग. It does not, however, look natural. सलिल—सलति", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "गच्छतीति, सल्+इलच्. Cf. the subhâshita एष वन्ध्यासुतो याति खपुष्प-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 14, "text": "कृतशेखरः । मृगतृष्णाम्भसि स्नातः शशशृङ्गधनुर्धरः ॥ wherein all the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "things generally spoken of as absolute impossibilities are", "end": "space"}, {"n": 16, "text": "brought together. Some discover in this sl. the fault yatibhanga", "end": "space"}, {"n": 17, "text": "or wrong Cæsura; see com.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "Sl. 6. व्याल—A wild elephant. Some take it to mean ‘a", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "serpent’ but without propriety, as it considerably impairs the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "force of the argument. Besides a serpent is not known to be tied", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "down while an elephant always is; cf. sl. 17. रोद्धुम्—To tie down.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "For the inf. see Apte’s G. § 176 and note. बालमृणाल०—मृणाल is", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "m. n. तन्तु is from तन्+तुन् समुज्जृम्भते—has a metaphorical", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "meaning here; strives, makes efforts. वज्रमणिः—a diamond.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "प्रान्तः–प्रकृष्टोन्तः–extreme edge. शिरीष is known to be the softest", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "flower. This shows the extreme folly of the act. सन्नह्यते—", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "prepares, makes himself ready for. It properly means to put on", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "an armour and thus to equip one’s self for battle; cf Mah. Bhá.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "युद्धाय सन्नह्यते. It is Atm. in this sense. पथि—The root नी governs", "end": "space"}, {"n": 14, "text": "two objects and the acc. would have been more idiomatic.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "But as पथि is not the principal object but only secondary, it", "end": "space"}, {"n": 16, "text": "depends upon the will of the speaker to put it in the acc. or", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "( 5 )", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": "Notes", "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": null, "label": null, "open_start": true, "open_end": false, "children": ["r2"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "5", "label": "Sl. 5", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "6", "label": "Sl. 6", "open_start": false, "open_end": true, "children": ["r4"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
